leadText:
----
 
Pokémon the Movie: Koko Theme Song Collection (Japanese: 「劇場版ポケットモンスター　ココ」テーマソング集) is a Japanese album that was released in Japan on December 23, 2020. It features ten songs by Taiiku Okazaki: six songs from the twenty-third movie, and four songs from Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon as bonus tracks. The Limited Edition includes a DVD featuring trailers, music videos, and creditless opening and ending footage, and a card.
